title: Homeowners Insurance Binder Credit on Builder Extended Rate Lock Extensions
content:
When the buyer's Homeowners Insurance with Calloway Insurance Agency is in place or quoted for the home, a credit applies to the extension fee percent of the Builder Extended Rate Lock.

**Rule.** Where the Calloway Insurance Agency Homeowners Insurance policy written for the lock's purchase agreement is bound or in force, 0.03125 percentage points are taken off the extension fee percent; where it is quoted, 0.015625 percentage points are taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off. The points are taken off the extension fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Status of the Homeowners Insurance policy for the purchase agreement | Taken off the extension fee percent |
|---|---|
| bound | 0.03125 percentage points |
| in force | 0.03125 percentage points |
| quoted | 0.015625 percentage points |
| any other status, or no policy | nothing |

## Basis questions

**Which policy is read?** The Homeowners Insurance policy written by Calloway Insurance Agency for the same purchase agreement the lock finances, and its status on that policy record.

**Hypothetical effect.** An extension fee percent of 0.125 with a bound policy becomes 0.09375; with a quoted policy, 0.109375.
